design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a Skydome corporate security trooper, average build, about seven heads tall: a grey-blue armored tactical uniform with a closed helmet and a dark visor, orange warning stripe lines, chest armor plate, shoulder pauldron, forearm guards and knee pads, black combat boots, dark gloves.
